input: Find a local fencing club for beginners

gold.taskTitle: Find a beginner fencing club near you
gold.taskDescription: Research and identify a local fencing club that accepts and is suitable for beginner-level participants.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood are you located in?
questions.description: Knowing the user's location narrows the search to relevant local clubs.

questions.title: How far are you willing to travel to the club?
questions.description: Understanding the acceptable travel distance or radius helps filter out clubs that are too far.

questions.title: Which fencing discipline interests you most?
questions.description: The three disciplines are foil, epee, and sabre — the user may have a preference or no knowledge yet.

questions.title: What is the age of the person who will be fencing?
questions.description: Age determines whether to look for youth, adult, or mixed-age beginner programs.

questions.title: Are you looking for recreational or competitive training?
questions.description: Some clubs focus on casual fitness-oriented fencing while others emphasize tournament preparation.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred schedule, such as evenings or weekends?
questions.description: Availability constraints will determine which clubs with matching session times are worth pursuing.

questions.title: What is your approximate budget for monthly fees or classes?
questions.description: Club membership costs vary widely; knowing the budget helps filter affordable options.
